name: io.github.bartoszgajda55/databricks-dev
title: Databricks Dev
description: Deploy, run and inspect Databricks bundles, jobs, pipelines and Unity Catalog via the databricks CLI

environmentVariables.name: DATABRICKS_BUNDLE_TARGET
environmentVariables.description: Default bundle target (default: the bundle's default target)

environmentVariables.name: DATABRICKS_BUNDLE_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Bundle directory (default: the server's working directory)

environmentVariables.name: DATABRICKS_CLI_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the databricks CLI (default: databricks on PATH)
